subject: NexusTech evaluation & security acceptance timeline
messages:
From: Alyssa Chang <alyssa.chang@finnex.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@nexustech.io
Date: Fri, 29 Nov 2029 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP & security checklist request

Hi Priya / Ben —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. NexusTech is moving this evaluation into a formal MAP and our security team needs a clear acceptance timeline and evidence list to present at our Dec 12 governance meeting. At minimum we need: SOC 2 report (or SOC bridge), SIG/CAIQ answers, a DPA we can review with retention clauses called out, and where data can be hosted (US-only vs multi-region).

Can you share a proposed mutual action plan with milestones and owners (we have internal reviewers who will run the DPA and SIG check next week)? Also, are there any quick wins you can commit to (short-term escrow, temporary audit access) to speed acceptance?

Appreciate it — Ops will be on cc for scheduling.

Best,
Alyssa
Director of IT Security
Finnex (prospective)

---
Alyssa Chang
Finnex

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chang <alyssa.chang@finnex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, ops@nexustech.io
Date: Mon, 02 Dec 2029 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & security checklist request

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks — attaching a first-pass MAP and a short SOC 2 summary. High level proposal below and attached:

- MAP milestone 0 (Dec 3): Delivery of SOC 2 summary + SIG snapshot (attached) and redlined DPA v2 for your counsel to review. Owner: Priya (Redwood).
- MAP milestone 1 (Dec 6): Evidence intake window — 1-week window to push requested artifacts to our secure review bucket (SOC 2 controls traces, encryption configuration, access logs). Owner: Ben (Redwood).
- MAP milestone 2 (Dec 10): Joint review call (30m) to confirm acceptance criteria and resolve any DPA carveouts. Owner: Alyssa + Priya.
- MAP milestone 3 (Dec 12): Governance decision by NexusTech. If green, we open commercial paperwork and target go-live acceptance for a pilot by Dec 20.

Quick wins we can offer now:
- Temporary read-only audit access (7 days) to a staging tenant for SOC evidence collection.
- A documented data retention/archival matrix for US regions (will include options for EU residency if required, note this adds timeline).

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx, DPA_redline_v2.docx

A couple of clarifying Qs for your security team so we can finalize the MAP:
1) For the SIG/CAIQ, do you prefer a full answers bundle or a prioritized control subset (we can provide a rapid subset in 48 hours)?
2) Is NexusTech looking for a hard US-only residency or will dual-region be acceptable for pilot?

I'll loop Karthik for technical confirmations on logging windows and Ben for evidence intake specifics.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chang <alyssa.chang@finnex.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Dec 2029 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & security checklist request

Alyssa / team —

Quick technical notes to align acceptance criteria (so NexusTech's reviewers have clear asks):

- SOC 2: We have a Type II covering 2028–2029 controls. For the MAP, we'll supply the condensed control mapping (what we can provide as evidence vs. what requires configuration snapshots). Expect the control evidence package within the milestone 1 window (Dec 6–13) if you opt-in to the intake slot.
- SIG/CAIQ: We can produce a prioritized subset (critical controls) within 48 hours of your confirmation; full SIG answers take ~10 business days to compile and annotate.
- DPA redlines: Priya attached our proposed language. A few Nexus carveouts (retention shorter than our defaults, escrow) will require legal review; flagging this early avoids late-blockers.
- Data retention: default retention tiers are documented in the attached MAP sheet. For a pilot we can scope to a 30-day hot retention + 1 year cold archive (US). If Nexus needs EU residency we should budget an extra 6–8 business days for provisioning and legal.

If Ops can confirm they want the prioritized SIG subset, we'll push that first and start compiling evidence for Milestone 1. Ben — can you confirm the intake S3 bucket ACL and the doc upload pattern?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chang <alyssa.chang@finnex.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Dec 2029 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP & security checklist request

Alyssa —

This aligns with our internal plan. To keep your Dec 12 governance decision on track here are concrete asks and an updated timeline (attached updated MAP_timeline_v1.xlsx):

Action items for NexusTech (by Dec 6):
- Confirm whether you want prioritized SIG subset (recommended for faster gating) or the full CAIQ.
- Confirm residency requirement for pilot (US-only vs EU option).
- Assign 1 evidence reviewer and provide their calendar availability for Dec 10 call.

Redwood commitments (completed or in progress):
- SOC2 summary and prioritized SIG subset (if requested) — delivered (attached).
- DPA redline v2 — attached for counsel review.
- Temp read-only audit access — provisioning starts Dec 6 (Ben).

If you confirm prioritized SIG and US pilot, our projected acceptance path: evidence intake Dec 6–12, joint review Dec 10, decision Dec 12, contract signature window Dec 13–17.

Alyssa — once you confirm the three asks above I will schedule the intake window and the Dec 10 call.

Best,
Priya
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
Priya@redwood.com
